column12: Reset_n for AVS Controller FSM. When set to 0 the AVS controller will reset its internal state and all FIFOs. This is a synchronous reset so it will take effect on the next clock cycle.
Pop the current entry of the readback FIFO.

Write 1 to this register to abort the current AVS transaction. If you are transitioning to a new transaction either from idle or the end of another transaction the new transaction will also be aborted.

Write 1 to this register to abort the current AVS transaction & flush the command FIFO. If you are transitioning to a new transaction either from idle or the end of another transaction this new transaction will also be aborted.
